notes.title: Coloring Contest - Halloween Edition!
notes.content:
Dear parents, 

Welcome to our coloring contest - Halloween edition! 🎃

[b]It starts today, October 28 at 9 am GMT+2 and it will end on Monday, November 1, at 5pm GMT+2. 
[/b]
The task is to color the image you see below, image no. 18 in the Halloween category. When the image is colored, take a screenshot, add caption #halloweencontest and share it with visibility set on public in the section for screenshots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39575320/941e50fe05dece4ee7823e0b2ec768859ea709ad.png[/img]

When the contest ends, we’re going to choose the top 3! Have fun with your kids and try your best to make your image look as Halloween-y as possible. 👻

[b]Note: [/b]One submission per participant is allowed.

[b]Our rewards are the following:[/b]
1. place - Coloring Book for Adults (Pro version) and DLC for the Coloring Book for Kids
2. place - DLC for the Coloring Book for Kids
3. place - DLC for the Coloring Book for Kids

We can't wait to see all of your works. 

All your submissions will be available here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1507410/screenshots/?searchText=halloweencontest&browsefilter=mostrecent&filterLanguage=default

Happy Halloween! 🎃

notes.title: Our Coloring Contest Impressions and a Shoutout!
notes.content:
Dear parents,

We'd like to share our impressions with you about the coloring contest we held about four weeks ago.

For starters, thank you for encouraging your kids to take part in it. We really hope you had some good family fun! :)
 
We really liked all of the artworks so we decided to give a shoutout to those that didn't get the reward this time as well. It was a difficult task to choose the top 3. We're truly happy that our contest sparked the kids' creativity!

notes.title: Coloring Contest
notes.content:
Dear parents, 

If your kids enjoy coloring, we've got something to keep them busy. They will even have a chance to win a nice reward! :) 

We’re inviting them to participate in our coloring contest! When? [b]From Monday, April 19, at 5pm GMT+2 to Monday, April 26, at 8am GMT+2.[/b] What they need to do? [b]Just color the image we have chosen. When they finish coloring the image, just take a screenshot, add caption #coloringcontest and share it with visibility set on public.[/b] 

The image they need to color is the one you see below, [b]image no. 14 in the Cats category in the app.[/b]

When the contest ends, we’re going to choose the top 3! 

Our rewards are the following:
1. place - Coloring Book for Adults (Pro version) and DLC for the Coloring Book for Kids
2. place - DLC for the Coloring Book for Kids
3. place - DLC for the Coloring Book for Kids

Message for the participants: Let your imagination run wild, create a piece of art! 

We’re looking forward to seeing all of your works. Happy coloring! :)
